primaryChecks.text: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The men of Judah said, “Why have you come up against us?” They said, “We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.”

primaryChecks.text: When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him. Then the LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burned with fire; and his bands dropped from off his hands.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.

primaryChecks.text: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
